Works right away with NASA's shared DEMO_KEY, but that's rate-limited and often fails. For a reliable image, get your own free key (takes ~30 seconds):
  1. Open api.nasa.gov
  2. Enter your first name, last name, and email under "Generate API Key"
  3. The key appears on screen instantly (also emailed to you)
  4. Paste it above
Tip: press the key on your Stream Deck to open today's picture full-size.
